5. Allowances and equipment
5.1 Small tools. Contractor may bill a small-tools allowance not exceeding 3.0% of submitted eligible direct craft labor charges. Eligible craft labor excludes superintendent time, overtime premiums, subcontractor labor, equipment, materials, PPE, and other reimbursables.
5.2 Equipment. Equipment is reimbursable at the lower of the itemized third-party invoice or the current contract equipment rate. Rate schedules apply to owned and rented equipment. Fuel and delivery are included unless separately authorized.

6. Cost eligibility and support
6.1 Materials. Materials must be project-related and reasonably consumed. Itemized receipts are required for any individual material charge over $500 unless a later amendment imposes a stricter threshold.
6.2 PPE and safety consumables. PPE may be reimbursed when project-specific and supported by an itemized receipt. Ordinary personal workwear is included in labor rates.
6.3 Meals. A project meal is reimbursable only when pre-approved for an extended outage or emergency coordination event and supported by an itemized receipt.
6.4 Alcohol. Alcoholic beverages are never reimbursable, even when included on an otherwise allowable meal receipt.

7. Review and payment
Owner will use commercially reasonable efforts to complete initial review within four business days and final disposition within eight business days after receiving a complete package. Time spent awaiting missing information may be recorded separately from active review time.
Approval of a prior invoice does not waive a contract term. Reviewer comments, evidence, and adjustments must remain associated with the monthly case for audit purposes.
